people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
translations.bsb: But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all the prophets, saying that His Christ would suffer.
translations.kjv: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
translations.asv: But the things which God foreshowed by the mouth of all the prophets, that his Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
